rationale: With only 22 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock is sitting near the low of its range (13.1% position), price action over the last 5 candles shows tight, low-volume consolidation with no directional momentum, and the ATR of ~$0.036 on 5-minute bars leaves minimal room for a meaningful move before close. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.38%, VIXY +6.49%) and the stock already gapped down 9%, suggesting sellers remain in control, but the compressed candles and thin volume offer no clean entry signal in either direction to justify the execution risk this late in the session.
